class.name: TamaManager
class.brief_description: Engine singleton that manages bullet pattern scripts, object type registration, and global state for Tama.
class.description:
[b]TamaManager[/b] is the central singleton for the Tama bullet hell framework. Access it via [code]TamaManager[/code] in GDScript.
Before any emitters can fire, load TamaScript files and register at least one object type. A minimal setup: [codeblock] func _ready(): TamaManager.set_registry(preload("res://my_registry.tres")) TamaManager.load_scripts() [/codeblock]
[b]Script loading[/b] reads [code].tama[/code] files from the directory configured in [code]tama/scripts_path[/code] (default: [code]res://tamascripts[/code]).
[b]Object types[/b] are registered in a [TamaBulletRegistry] via [member registry] or imperatively via [method register_server_bullet]. The registry supports three server-side types (all subclasses of [TamaServerObjectConfig]): - [TamaServerBulletConfig] — MultiMesh bullets with CPU circle collision. - [TamaServerStraightLaserConfig] — beam lasers with a four-phase lifetime and CPU segment collision. - [TamaServerCurvedLaserConfig] — ribbon-trail lasers with CPU segment collision against the full trail.
[b]Collision[/b] for all server types is a CPU point/segment test against [member player_position] performed every physics frame. No PhysicsServer2D involvement. Hits are reported via the [signal bullet_hit], [signal straight_laser_hit], and [signal curved_laser_hit] signals.
[member player_position] and [member player_hitbox_radius] must be kept up to date every frame.

method.name: load_scripts
method.description: Loads all [code].tama[/code] files found in [param path]. If [param path] is empty, uses the directory from the [code]tama/scripts_path[/code] project setting (default: [code]res://tamascripts[/code]).

method.name: load_script
method.description: Loads a single TamaScript file. [param filename] is the bare name used to reference the script (e.g. [code]"spiral"[/code]); [param full_path] is the resource path.

method.name: load_script_from_source
method.description: Parses and registers a TamaScript directly from a source string. Useful for procedurally generated or runtime-defined patterns.

method.name: register_bullet
method.description: Registers a scene-based bullet type under [param type]. Emitters that reference this type instantiate [param scene] per bullet. Use [method register_server_bullet] for better performance with many simultaneous bullets.

method.name: register_server_bullet
method.description: Registers a server bullet type under [param type]. Prefer setting [member registry] to a [TamaBulletRegistry] asset when you have multiple types to register at once.

method.name: set_default_bullet
method.description: Sets the fallback [PackedScene] used when a TamaScript fires a bullet with a type not found in the registry.

method.name: get_player_position
method.description: Returns the current player position used for [code]aim[/code] direction and collision calculations.

method.name: set_player_position
method.description: Sets the player world position. Call every frame so that [code]aim[/code] directions and CPU collision tests stay accurate.

method.name: get_player_hitbox_radius
method.description: Returns the player's hitbox radius used in CPU collision tests.

method.name: set_player_hitbox_radius
method.description: Sets the player's hitbox radius in pixels. The CPU collision tests for bullets and lasers add this value to their own shape radius/half-width when checking for overlap with [member player_position].

method.name: get_spawn_parent
method.description: Returns the [NodePath] under which scene bullets are added as children.

method.name: set_spawn_parent
method.description: Sets the node under which scene bullets are spawned. Defaults to the scene root when empty.

method.name: get_context
method.description: Returns the active [TamaContext]. Subclass [TamaContext] and set a custom instance to expose game-specific values to TamaScript expressions.

method.name: set_context
method.description: Replaces the active [TamaContext]. Set before emitters start.

method.name: get_registry
method.description: Returns the [TamaBulletRegistry] that maps type names to configs and scenes.

method.name: set_registry
method.description: Replaces the active [TamaBulletRegistry]. Useful for loading a pre-configured registry asset from disk rather than registering types imperatively.

method.name: destroy_server_bullet
method.description:
Recycles [param bullet] back to the pool. Safe to call directly from a [signal bullet_hit] handler. [codeblock] func _ready(): TamaManager.bullet_hit.connect(_on_bullet_hit)
func _on_bullet_hit(bullet: TamaServerBullet) -> void: TamaManager.destroy_server_bullet(bullet) [/codeblock]

method.name: recycle_all
method.description: Immediately recycles all active server bullets, straight lasers, and curved lasers. Useful for clearing the screen on scene transitions or player death.

method.name: get_server_bullet_pool
method.description: Returns the internal [TamaServerBulletPool] node. Prefer [method destroy_server_bullet] for destroying individual bullets.

method.name: get_laser_pool
method.description: Returns the internal [TamaServerLaserPool] node used for straight lasers.

method.name: get_curved_laser_pool
method.description: Returns the internal [TamaServerCurvedLaserPool] node used for curved lasers.

method.name: get_bullet_count
method.description: Returns the total number of currently active server objects (bullets + straight lasers + curved lasers). Also accessible as the read-only [member bullet_count] property.

members.member: Current player world position. Update every frame for correct [code]aim[/code] direction resolution and CPU collision.
Radius of the player's hitbox in pixels. Added to each object's own shape radius/half-width when performing the CPU collision test.
Node path under which scene-based bullets are added. Defaults to the scene root when empty.
Active context object queried by TamaScript expressions. Replace with a [TamaContext] subclass to expose custom values.
Registry that maps type names to configs and scenes.
When ≥ 0, overrides the [member TamaServerObjectConfig.out_of_bounds_margin] of every registered type. [code]-1[/code] (default) means each type uses its own margin.
Total active server objects across all types. Read-only.

signal.name: bullet_hit
signal.description:
Emitted when the CPU collision test detects that [param bullet] overlaps the player hitbox. Destroy the bullet from within this handler: [codeblock] func _ready(): TamaManager.bullet_hit.connect(_on_bullet_hit)
func _on_bullet_hit(bullet: TamaServerBullet) -> void: TamaManager.destroy_server_bullet(bullet) [/codeblock] Not emitted for scene bullets (use normal [Area2D] collision signals on those).

signal.name: straight_laser_hit
signal.description:
Emitted when the CPU collision test detects that a straight laser's active beam segment overlaps the player hitbox. Only emitted during phases 1 (expand) and 2 (active); not during delay or fade. [codeblock] func _ready(): TamaManager.straight_laser_hit.connect(_on_laser_hit)
func _on_laser_hit(laser: TamaServerLaser) -> void: pass # handle player hit [/codeblock]

signal.name: curved_laser_hit
signal.description:
Emitted when the CPU collision test detects that any segment of a curved laser's trail overlaps the player hitbox. [codeblock] func _ready(): TamaManager.curved_laser_hit.connect(_on_curved_laser_hit)
func _on_curved_laser_hit(laser: TamaServerCurvedLaser) -> void: pass # handle player hit [/codeblock]

signal.name: event_fired
